title: terraform: refactor private GPU node pools, IAM roles, networking and state layout
author: Priya Khandelwal
release_notes: Refactor Terraform modules for Private deployments: reorganized GPU node pools, standardized IAM role module, improved VPC networking layout, and updated state backend layout for safer upgrades. No user-facing API changes expected; provider upgrades may be required.
description:
Motivation: Private deployments have diverged across customers and environments due to ad-hoc module composition for GPU node pools, IAM, and networking. This PR consolidates and refactors the Terraform modules used for Private (VPC/on-prem) installer so future upgrades (including node pool autoscaling and cluster upgrades) are safer and deterministic.

What this changes: - Introduces a dedicated module 'gpu_node_pool' that encapsulates GPU instance types, taints/labels, autoscaler config, and node pool lifecycle scripts. - Extracts a reusable 'iam_role' module with clear input/output contract for workload IAM bindings and KMS integration. - Reworks 'networking' module to separate control-plane, mgmt, and workload subnets; adds explicit NAT/GW attachments for private clusters. - Updates state layout: moves per-environment state into env-scoped workspaces/backends and introduces locking with a recommended DynamoDB table (for AWS) or GCS lock bucket (for GCP). - Adds migration helpers and an upgrade plan generator script to reduce drift during state moves.

Backward compatibility and upgrade plan: Upgrades are staged. Existing deployments can use the migration helpers to generate a move plan. We included tests and example migration commands in docs/upgrade.md. Consumers should verify provider versions (>= 4.50 for aws, >= 5.1 for google) before applying.

Testing: - Unit tests for modules (terraform validate + tflint) - Integration smoke tests in perf-canary staging cluster (apply/destroy) - Manual migration dry-runs on two internal staging envs.

Checklist: - [x] Module refactor implemented - [x] Migration helpers and docs added - [x] CI checks passing - [x] Reviewers approved - [x] Release notes drafted

Notes: This PR intentionally does not change runtime configuration defaults; it focuses on layout and modularization. Follow-up PR will add autoscaling tuning recommendations and example kustomize manifests for on-prem installers.

notes_for_ops: Before applying to production: 1) run scripts/migration/generate_move_plan.py --env prod --dry-run and review generated plan; 2) ensure remote state locking enabled (DynamoDB/GCS); 3) coordinate with infra on maintenance window for large clusters.
